scrcpy-server-v3.3.3 is the unmodified server from the official scrcpy release
https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/releases/tag/v3.3.3  (Apache-2.0, (c) Genymobile)
SHA-256: 7e70323ba7f259649dd4acce97ac4fefbae8102b2c6d91e2e7be613fd5354be0
Compare it with the checksum on the release page before publishing a build.
To update: replace the file, then change SERVER_VERSION in ../adbctl.js (the server refuses a mismatching version).
